content.short: Rattle is an EVM static analysis framework designed to work on deployed smart contracts.
content.description: Rattle provides a static analysis framework for deployed smart contracts. Built to illuminate how contracts interact, it enables developers to parse EVM byte strings and generate a comprehensive control-flow graph that covers the entire set of related contracts. Using this graph, Rattle optimizes the SSA representation of the code, trimming roughly 60% of EVM instructions and removing noise that obscures logic. This approach supports clearer auditing, verification, and safer interaction with on-chain behavior.
